_notes: Drives the Org Chart (docs/org-chart.md). Who is IN each department comes from people.json automatically. Only leaders and the Executive box are listed here. Departments appear in the chart in the order below; a department that isn't listed here is left off the chart. Each department's description is shown on its page in the Departments section (docs/departments/).

departments.name: Music
departments.description: Composes and directs the music and sound of CodaCode's games, from themes to sound effects.

departments.name: Art
departments.description: Creates the look of the games: characters, environments, interface art and overall art direction.

departments.name: Ideas
departments.description: Where concepts begin. Brainstorms game ideas, mechanics, worlds and features for the studio to pursue.

departments.name: Writing
departments.description: Writes the stories, dialogue and lore, and keeps the narrative consistent across projects.

departments.name: QA
departments.description: Quality Assurance. Tests the games, finds and reports bugs, and checks that everything works before release.
